trigger: Reviewer parks a non-blocking I1 finding; Gate 8's steps never mention dispositions, so the park bar is verified only in the post-push filing procedure
summary: The park constraint's VERIFICATION did not travel with the rule: stated at a post-push procedure, so the control is checked after the gate said PASS
classification_rationale: For a runbook the control IS the text; unreachable-at-decision-time is a truth defect, not wording

trigger: Reviewer runs the stated mechanical check, gets a clean result, treats both park constraints as verified
summary: 'Both facts are mechanically checkable from the ledger' is false - the label XOR is not a ledger field - and the pattern keyed on roadmap- only, so a linked-to- park was invisible
classification_rationale: A clean result presented as coverage the check cannot deliver is false assurance

trigger: Agent fills a rejected row for a derived-CRITICAL finding, reads the ledger-schema row, lets the original raiser sign its own rejection
summary: The commit broadened the rejected adjudicator rule at Gate 7 and left the narrower 'non-author' copy in the ledger-schema row it edited in the same commit
classification_rationale: Two live standards for one disposition; the weaker sat in the more-consulted place

trigger: Editor tightens the rule at the procedure; the Gate 7 summary is left untouched and drops 'whatever its derived band'
summary: The Gate 7 summary was a LOSSY restatement, omitting the band-independence clause that defeats the 'mine derived MEDIUM' misread
classification_rationale: Adjudicated against both copies directly; security-guardian read them as agreeing and they do not. Disagreement resolved by orchestrator (read both copies; consistency-auditor upheld over security-guardian).

trigger: Reviewer promotes a duplicate target out of roadmap and looks for 'the ledger row's rationale'
summary: Instruction named a ledger field that does not exist; nearest real field is waiver_rationale, which would contaminate waiver evidence with a routine promotion

trigger: Gov passes, push, merge, then filing - the stated #N amendment window has already closed
summary: Merge closed the #N amendment window with no rule for the case, so a fragment could permanently read roadmap-#? and a park become unauditable

trigger: Two reviewers record the same dedupe-onto-existing outcome differently
summary: linked-to-#N added with no definition, overlapping deferred-to-issue #N; a plain SPLIT outcome had no enum value at all

trigger: Future editor aligns the floor exception DOWN to match the claimed equivalence
summary: The adjudicator rule claimed to be 'the same separation' as the floor exception while stating a different (stricter) standard

trigger: Reader consults the changelog fragment for what shipped
summary: Fragment still described the pre-broadening adjudicator rule and omitted the check, the enum additions and the amend rule

trigger: Reader checks the justification for the promotion instruction against triage-labels.md
summary: Promotion justification overclaimed triage-labels.md, which requires a priority only 'once triaged'
classification_rationale: Folded in pass 8 and the fold REGRESSED correct text - see P9-03. Recorded here because the cause matters more than the finding

trigger: Reviewer treats 'Check it before the run report goes out' as an executed control
summary: The mechanical check named no actor, no command and no consequence, against this file's own 'enforced by the filesystem rather than assumed' standard

trigger: Reader follows 'the two constraints above' and lands on the lossy summary
summary: 'the two constraints above' pointed ~185 lines the wrong way after the relocation

trigger: A run parks two findings and files none; the reader sees a filing-only section title and concludes it does not apply
summary: The relocation target's title and entry sentence were filing-only, so the park command and bar were not reachable on a park-only run

trigger: Reader greps 'filing procedure' and lands on the section that disclaims itself
summary: The pointer's only grep handle resolved to the wrong section

trigger: Agent fills the adjudicated_by field for a derived-CRITICAL rejected row, reads that field's own definition, signs its own rejection as the raiser
summary: The pass-8 fix corrected the disposition cell and left the identical construct in the adjudicated_by cell one row below; that field serves three dispositions with three different standards so it can carry none
caused_by: P8-03 fix (incomplete - fixed one of two copies)

trigger: A YUZU_GOV_LOG_DIR run: the hardcoded governance.d path is absent, jq exits 2, and the runbook's own 'the PASS case is the non-zero one' converts that into a pass
summary: The check added to enforce constraint 1 silently self-disarmed: hardcoded path instead of $LEDGER, with exit 2 read as clean by the sentence explaining the inverted exit code

trigger: Reviewer promotes an issue out of roadmap per the instruction and leaves it non-roadmap + needs-triage + no priority, which the gh-path rule forbids
summary: The pass-8 fold of P8-10 regressed correct text: it applied the any-path telemetry invariant where the binding gh-path rule (issue-standard.md §4, ADR-3001) requires a priority alongside the triage state
classification_rationale: Reviewers disagreed - docs-writer verified the citation true against triage-labels.md:86, consistency-auditor blocked it against issue-standard.md:89-92. Adjudicated by reading both sources; the gh path is the one governance uses. Disagreement resolved by orchestrator (read issue-standard.md 83-105, triage-labels.md 84-90, ADR-3001 339-348; consistency-auditor upheld).
caused_by: P8-10 fold (a NICE finding folded without checking the binding rule)

trigger: An I1 finding legitimately deduped onto an existing ACTIVE prioritised issue matches the linked-to- arm and the gate blocks until re-dispositioned
summary: linked-to- over-matches by construction and the mandated remedy was worse than the match, pushing the reviewer toward filing a duplicate or thinning the impact list
caused_by: P8-02 fix (widening the pattern to cover linked-to-)

trigger: A row records "impact": "I1" as a scalar; .impact[]? swallows the type error and the check exits 4
summary: Scalar impact slipped the check entirely; filter now normalises with if type == "array"

trigger: Reader audits the parked-count aside against the tracker
summary: 'which was true when written' was false - measured 338 of 1281 with the parked set flat and open up 233, it was last true around 2026-07-20

trigger: Reviewer follows 'amend on dev in a follow-up commit' against a protected branch
summary: dev is protected, so a direct follow-up commit is not a path; corrected to a follow-up PR

trigger: Reader reconciles Gate 7's attribution of the label XOR with Gate 8 step 4's blind-spot list
summary: Gate 7 folded the label XOR into constraint 2, Gate 8 treated it as separate, and it is in neither constraint

trigger: The pre-pass check is assigned to 'whoever writes the run report', an artefact that exists only post-push
summary: The check's timing was fixed but its owner was named by a post-push artefact, putting it back after the decision

trigger: A Codex-side run applies the narrower MEDIUM/SHOULD disposition rule
summary: The Codex runner's disposition rule is restated rather than deferred, so it can contradict this section
classification_rationale: Adjudicated INAPPLICABLE to this change. CLAUDE.md's runner-parity sentence is scoped by its own words -- 'Both /governance runners apply THIS ONE RULE' -- and sits inside standing rule 2 (severity derivation), which this change does not touch; the disposition step is a new Gate 7 addition, not a standing rule. 40dd8105 named this file canonical and assigned reconciliation to the .codex runner's owner. An earlier revision of this row recorded linked-to-#2604, but #2604 is a MERGED PR rather than an open issue, so that value presented a rejected finding as tracked work. Kimi reached the same conclusion independently, labelling Codex's finding 'disagrees'.

trigger: Reviewer greps classification_rationale for truth-vs-wording reasoning and gets reviewer-disagreement adjudication prose instead; two rows also ran on without a sentence terminator
summary: The adjudicated_by fix moved reviewer-disagreement records into classification_rationale, a field the schema scopes to truth-vs-wording; the schema now sanctions the second use explicitly rather than leaving it undeclared
classification_rationale: Raised by consistency-auditor and compliance-officer independently. The pass-9 fix was schema-CORRECT to vacate adjudicated_by, but landed the content in a field that did not declare it. Closed by extending the schema row rather than adding a field, since the ledger is committed evidence and a new nullable column would leave every prior fragment invalid.
caused_by: P9-01 fix (nulling adjudicated_by on fixed rows)
